title: CertOps Signed Dispatch Payload
description: Shared definitions for the fields that ARE SIGNED on every signed-dispatch job, regardless of action (ADR-0012 decision 3). This file deliberately does NOT define 'signature': the signature is computed over these fields, so it cannot be one of them. A v2 payloadB64 decode must contain no signature field at all, and the v1 wire object's top-level signature is excluded when recomputing canonical bytes -- signature is therefore a property of the WIRE WRAPPER, defined in signed-dispatch-wire-v1.schema.json, not of the signed payload. See signed-dispatch-wire-v2.schema.json for the v2 wrapper. Composed by job-payload.schema.json (alongside its certificate-specific required fields, unchanged) and by protocol-smoke-payload.schema.json (which needs none of the certificate fields). This file is the single source of truth for the shape of these fields; both per-action schemas $ref into it by $id rather than duplicating field definitions, so they cannot drift apart on what a signed field looks like. schemaVersion/jobId/workspaceId/action/mode/requestedAt are shared with the unsigned/bootstrap shape; agentId/issuedAt/expiresAt/nonce/signingKeyId/claimId/attemptId/leaseExpiresAt/attemptCount exist only once a job is actually signed for dispatch. This definition intentionally carries no top-level 'required' list of its own: each composing schema decides which of these fields it requires. protocol-smoke-payload.schema.json, being new, has required agentId from day one; job-payload.schema.json now requires it too, added atomically with the control plane's server-side agentId emission (both land in the same change, so there is never a state where the control plane is supposed to emit the field but its own schema would accept a payload without it).

agentId.description: ADR-0012 decision 3: the agentId this job is signed for, binding the dispatch to one agent identity so a captured envelope cannot be replayed against a different agent. Required by the producer schemas from the moment the control plane emits it (both land in the same change; the producer schema is never optional-then-required, because a schema that permits omitting the field cannot catch a dispatch path that forgets it). Consumer-side tolerance for a control plane that has not yet deployed emission lives in a separate compatibility decoder gated on CERTOPS_AGENT_REQUIRE_SIGNED_AGENT_ID, never in this schema: absence may be tolerated there while that flag's effective value is false, but a value that is PRESENT AND MISMATCHED always fails closed regardless of the flag. Clients advertise agent-id-binding-v1 based on the flag's effective value in the running process, not on their release's compiled-in default.

action.description: Generic shape only. Each composing schema layers its own stricter action property (a fixed enum for certificate jobs, a const for protocol_smoke) via allOf; this definition does not constrain which action values are valid.

mode.description: First-class immutable job execution mode set at creation. dry_run jobs must terminate as dry_run_complete, never succeeded.

issuedAt.description: Signed agent dispatch: job dispatch timestamp.

expiresAt.description: Signed agent dispatch: signed job validity bound.

nonce.description: Signed agent dispatch: single-use nonce for signed job replay protection.

signingKeyId.description: Signed agent dispatch: identifier of the control-plane operational signing key. This is the ONE field that legitimately appears both here and on the v2 wire wrapper: the wrapper's copy is the pre-verification key-selection hint (read before any signature verdict exists), this copy is the authenticated value, and ADR-0012 decision 2 step 13 requires the two to be equal after verification so a wrapper hint cannot silently point at a different key than the one the payload claims.

claimId.description: Signed agent dispatch: claim identifier the agent must echo back with the result (ownership re-proof).

attemptId.description: Signed agent dispatch: server-assigned attempt id mirroring claimId, so a schema-minimal result report (attemptId only) still re-proves claim ownership.

leaseExpiresAt.description: Signed agent dispatch: current claim lease expiry, echoed on dispatch so the agent can plan lease renewal.

attemptCount.description: Signed agent dispatch: number of claim attempts made for this job so far.
